title: PM <> Eng Lead 1:1 — Roadblock scan and quick wins
body:
Purpose: quick triage before Monday EOD sync with eng leadership. Goal: identify 3 riskiest blockers across API/Console/Dedicated/Private and agree owners + mitigation paths. Also surface 2 fast wins (<=2 days) that unblock product momentum.

Tone: informal notes — jotting actions, unresolved questions, and minimal context for follow-ups. Not a final report.

Context snapshot:
- Hosted API: 99.9% of trial traffic; sporadic high tail latency during long chat sessions (seq len > 8k). Suspect kernel selection + KV cache eviction policy.
- Console: UX rollout for route-level quotas planned next sprint; backend work to expose per-route token breakdown incomplete.
- Dedicated: Provisioning flow has a 12–18 hour bootstrap for GPU pools in certain regions; customers hit this and escalate.
- Private: On-prem install tests show KMS integration failing intermittently (timeout to HSM), only under high inode/fs pressure on installer VM.

Non-goals for this note: deep performance profiling, full runbook drafts.
meeting_agenda: 20m: roadblock scan — top 3 cross-cutting risks and current mitigation options
10m: quick wins candidates and owner commitments
10m: decisions needed from me (PM) and from you (Eng lead)
5m: scheduling follow-ups + who to loop in
notes:
Risk 1 — Hosted API tail latency:
- Evidence: 3 customer tickets + synthetic perf job shows 95th/99th spikes when prefix cache miss rate > 60%.
- Suspected causes: suboptimal kernel selection for long seqs; KV eviction thrashing under bursty traffic.
- Current mitigation: fallback to compact models available but quality drop observed for 2 customers.
- Ask: can we add a short A/B test to toggle aggressive KV retention for small subset (5%) to measure effect?

Risk 2 — Dedicated provisioning timeouts:
- Evidence: provision logs show repeated infra agent retries hitting cloud provider rate limits in eu-west-3.
- Suspected causes: single retry loop with exponential backoff capped too low; lack of early detection and user-visible ETA.
- Mitigation options: increase retry budget, surface estimated ETA in console, add quick 'probe' step to pre-reserve resources.
- Ask: engineering estimate for increasing retry budget vs adding probe (effort/cost)?

Risk 3 — Private KMS flakiness during install:
- Evidence: two installs failed during key wrap step; network flakiness + disk pressure correlate in VMs.
- Proposed short fix: detect low free inodes+disk and fail fast with clear remediation before KMS handshake.
- Longer fix: make KMS handshake idempotent and add exponential backoff with jitter.
- Ask: can solutions-eng include a preflight hook in installer this sprint?

Quick win candidate A — Console per-route token breakdown endpoint (low risk):
- Work: add an internal-only endpoint returning token counts for last 24h by route; front-end reads this for quota view.
- Estimate: 1.5 dev days + 0.5 d QA.
- Owner: Samir Rao (backend) + Maya Li (frontend).

Quick win candidate B — Canary flag for KV retention policy (very small blast radius):
- Work: add runtime flag to extend KV retention from 30s->2m for selected customer ids.
- Estimate: 1 dev day + perf smoke test.
- Owner: Eng runtime on-call (TBD).
Notes on communication: escalate customers with SLA exposure to CS now; for the rest include note in next weekly status with mitigation ETA.
decisions: Try short A/B with KV retention policy for 5% of traffic (agree to measure tail latency and token cost).
Add console ETA for Dedicated provisioning (UX stub) and track provisioning telemetry next sprint.
Implement installer preflight disk/inode check before KMS handshake in Private installer; treat as release blocker for on-prem GA.
open_questions: Who owns the runtime flag rollout (runtime team or infra ops)? Need a named owner before monday.
What's the expected unit cost impact if we increase KV retention for 5% traffic? (quick back-of-envelope needed)
Is there appetite to accept temporary quality drop for some customers while we stabilize tail latency (tradeoff discussion)?
action_items: Aarav: Draft A/B plan and measurement harness (SLOs, metrics, success criteria) — due 2026-03-15
Samir Rao: API endpoint for per-route token counts — start WIP, PR by 2026-03-12
Maya Li: Console ETA UI stub + copy for provisioning errors — prototype by 2026-03-14
Runtime on-call (assign): Implement KV retention flag + perf smoke test — aim for 2026-03-18
Solutions Eng: Add preflight disk/inode check to installer flow and document remediation steps — 2026-03-16
CS (Marta): Begin customer comms for affected Dedicated customers and collect escalations — ongoing, update by 2026-03-13
quick_risk_matrix: Severity (S): Hosted API tail latency = High; Dedicated provisioning delay = Medium; Private KMS flakiness = High
Likelihood (L): Hosted API = Medium; Dedicated = High; Private KMS = Low-to-Medium
Mitigation urgency: Hosted API = Immediate A/B + perf runs; Dedicated = near-term infra change + ETA; Private = release blocker for on-prem GA
final_notes: If we cannot name runtime owner in today sync, I will escalate to eng director to get a dedicated resource. Keep this doc as living scratchpad — will convert to a short runbook if actions land.
